text: Databricks & Delta Lake Lesson 38 already covered the object hierarchy in full. This course assumes you have that picture already — this lesson is what that picture leaves out.
One governance layer, shared across every workspace attached to it. That's the whole picture at the level Lesson 38 needed it — this chapter goes further.
A metastore can attach to many workspaces, but a catalog inside it can be bound to just a subset of them — readable only from the workspaces that actually need it.
A new team's instinct is often to want its own metastore. In practice, one metastore per region is standard, with isolation handled by catalog bindings instead.
Same hierarchy, a level deeper: bindings, not separate metastores. Next up: catalogs, schemas, and external locations.
